steps: Heat the oil and drop in the bay leaf for a few seconds.
Fry the onion and green chilli until deep golden.
Add the ginger and garlic and stir until the raw smell goes.
Add the tomato, turmeric and salt and cook until mushy.
Lower the heat and stir in the yogurt, chilli powder, coriander powder and garam masala until it smells good.
Add the chicken and fry until it turns pale on all sides.
Pour in hot water, cover and simmer on low until the chicken is tender.
Stir in the crushed kasuri methi and top with coriander leaves.
note: Chicken is bone-in weight: the sources give 167 to 250 g a person, and 200 g is a normal adult share. One source writes onion as both 1 cup and 3 medium; about 55 g a person matches the other two.
